import pandas as pd
import os

# Read the input matrix
input_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year if present)
# First, let's see what columns we have
print("Columns in input:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Sample:")
print(df.head())

# Columns to exclude from indicator analysis
exclude_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

print("Indicator columns:", indicator_cols)

# Compute missingness per indicator
missingness_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total if total > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': round(missing_rate, 10),  # Keep precision
        'kept': kept
    })

missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)
print("\nMissingness report:")
print(missingness_df)

# Write missingness report
os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)
missingness_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = missingness_df[missingness_df['kept'] == True]['indicator'].tolist()
print("\nKept indicators:", kept_indicators)

# Create selected matrix
# Keep city_id, city_name, year, and kept indicator columns
keep_cols = [col for col in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] if col in df.columns]
keep_cols += kept_indicators

selected_df = df[keep_cols].copy()
print("\nSelected matrix shape:", selected_df.shape)
print("Selected matrix columns:", selected_df.columns.tolist())
print("Selected matrix sample:")
print(selected_df.head())

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("\nDone! Files written:")
print("  - outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv")
print("  - outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
</solution_file>
